title: A formally smooth local map of Noetherian local rings is flat with geometrically regular closed fibre
statement: Let $\varphi:(A,\mathfrak m_A)\to(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_A)\subseteq\mathfrak m_B$) of Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local rings, let $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$ and let $\overline B=B\otimes_Ak=B/\mathfrak m_AB$ be the closed fibre, a Noetherian $k$-algebra. If $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic], then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $\overline B$ is geometrically regular over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], i.e. $k'\otimes_k\overline B$ is a regular ring for every finite purely inseparable field extension $k'/k$.

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07NQ (proposition-fs-flat-fibre-fs, line 10081), implication (3) => (1), and its proof: Lemma 07NP (formally-smooth-flat) for flatness, Lemma 07EG (base-change-fs) for the closed fibre, Theorem 07EL (regular-fs) for (2) => (1). The source's formal smoothness is Definition 07NI with A carrying the m_A-adic topology; for a local homomorphism it is the condition of def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic (Lemma 07EC(2))

proof.text: Apply RingHom.flat_of_formallySmoothAdic to the local map and the given adic lifting property to prove flatness.

The ideal I = m_A B is proper by IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_lt_top. Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff makes B/I nonzero; IsLocalRing.of_surjective' applied to the quotient map makes it local. The quotient Noetherian instance supplies Noetherianity, and IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective identifies its maximal ideal with the image of m_B.

Apply Algebra.formallySmoothAdic_tensorProduct to A, B and k = A/m_A. Mathlib quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot identifies B/I with B tensor_A k as a B-algebra. Restrict scalars to A and use extendScalarsOfSurjective to make this a k-algebra equivalence e for the tensor rightAlgebra. For any lifting problem g on B/I, use g composed with e.symm on the tensor product. Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.map_map and the identity e.symm composed with includeLeft = quotient map show that the same positive power of the extended maximal ideal is killed. Apply the existing base-change theorem and compose its lift with e. Evaluation of the lifting equality at e(x) verifies the quotient lift. Rewrite the mapped maximal ideal as the maximal ideal of B/I.

Apply Algebra.isGeometricallyRegular_of_formallySmoothAdic to the Noetherian local closed fibre over A/m_A using its quotient algebra structure and the formal smoothness established in step 3. Pair this result with flatness from step 1.
